claim: CloudFront's security overview lists, among the ways to secure and restrict access to content, preventing users in specific geographic locations from accessing content, requiring CloudFront signed URLs or signed cookies, setting up field-level encryption for specific content fields, and using AWS WAF to control access.

evidence.quote: Prevent users in specific geographic locations from accessing content
Require users to access content using CloudFront signed URLs or signed cookies
Set up field-level encryption for specific content fields
Use AWS WAF to control access to your content
